verses: (tamam cheezen) jo aasmano aur zamin mein hain Allah ki paki biyan kerti hain ussi ki saltanat hai aur ussi ki tareef hai, aur woh her her cheez per qadir hai
Ussi ney tumhen peda kiya hai so tum mein say baazay to kafir hain aur baaz eman walay hain, aur jo kuch tum ker rahey ho Allah Taalaa khoob dekh raha hai
Ussi ney aasmano ko aur zamin ko adal o hikmat say peda kiya, ussi ney tumhari soorten banayen aur boht achi banayen aur ussi ki taraf lotna hai
Woh aasman o zamin ki her her cheez ka ilm rakhta hai aur jo kuch tum chupao aur jo zahir kero woh (sab ko) janta hai. Allah to seenon ki baaton tak ko jannay wala hai
Kiya tumharay pass uss say pehlay kay kafiron ki khabar nahi phonchi? Jinhon ney apney aemaal ka wabaal chakh liya aur jin kay liye dard-naak azab hai

Yeh uss liye kay unn kay pass unn kay rasool wazeh dalaeel ley ker aaye to unhon ney keh diya kay kiya insan humari rehnumaee keray ga? Pus inkar ker diya aur mun pher liya aur Allah ney bhi niazi ki, aur Allah to hai hi boht bey-niaz sab khoobiyon wala

Unn kafiron ney khayal kiya hai kay doobara zindah na kiye jayen gay. Aap keh dijiye kay kiyon nahi Allah ki qasam! tum zaroor doobara uthaye jao gay phir jo tum ney kiya hai uss ki khabar diye jao gay aur Allah per yeh bilkul hi aasan hai
So tum Allah per aur uss kay rasool per aur uss noor per jissay hum ney nazil farmaya hai eman lao aur Allah Taalaa tumharay her amal per ba-khabar hai

Jiss din tum sab ko uss jama honey kay din jama keray ga o hi din hai haar jeet ka aur jo shakhs Allah per eman ker nek amal keray Allah uss say uss ki buraiyan door ker dey ga aur ussay jannaton mein dakhil keray ga jin kay neechay nehren beh rahi hain jin mein woh hamesha hamesha rahen gay. Yehi boht bari kaamyabi hai
Aur jin logon ney kufur kiya aur humari aayaton ko jhutlaya o hi (sab) jahannumi hain (jo) jahannum mein hamesha rahen gay, woh boht bura thikana hai
Koi museebat Allah ki ijazat kay baghair nahi phonch sakti, jo Allah per eman laye Allah uss kay dil ko hidayat deta hai aur Allah her cheez ko khoob jannay wala hai
(logo) Allah ka kehna mano aur rasool ka kehna mano. Pus agar tum aeyraaz kero to humaray rasool kay zimmay sirf saaf saaf phoncha dena hai
Allah kay siwa koi mabood bar-haq nahi aur mominon ko Allah hi per tawakkal rakhna chahaiye

Aey eman walo! tumhari baaz biwiyan aur baaz bachay tumharay dushman hain pus unn say hoshiyaar rehna aur agar tum moaf ker do aur darguzar ker jao aur bakhsh do to Allah Taalaa bakhshney wala meharban hai
Tumharay maal aur aulad to sirasir tumhari aazmaeesh hain. Aur boht bara ajar Allah kay pass hai

Pus jahan tak tum say hosakay Allah say dartay raho aur suntay aur mantay chalay jao aur Allah ki raah mein kheyraat kertay raho jo tumharay liye behtar hai aur jo shakhs apney nafs ki hirss say mehfooz rakha jaye o hi kaamyaab hai

Agar tum Allah ko acha qarz do gay (yani uss ki raah mein kharach kero gay) to woh ussay tumharay liye barhata jaye ga aur tumharay gunah bhi moaf farma dey ga. Allah bara qadar daan bara burdbaar hai
Woh posheedah aur zahir ka jannay wala hai zabardast hikmat wala (hai)
